notes.title: 7.15.2019 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello citizens of Gamindustri!

We have released a new build today for Cyberdimension Neptunia™: 4 Goddesses Online that addresses the issues below:

 DLC costume name not appearing correctly is fixed
 Blanc’s skill Spiral Breeze’s effects not executing properly when used in the air is fixed.
 Japanese text showing up in the room search is fixed.
 Directional button input not working in the title screen config menu is fixed.


We appreciate your patience and support!
